prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Nicolás, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Nicolás thinks the municipal pool has been badly maintained for years.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I’m hearing some concerning rumors that the pool might be closed for the summer due to potential contamination issues. I’m not sure how much of this is true, as the staff have always been very diligent, but it’s worth keeping an eye on."
text: The municipal pool is officially a toxic hazard and will be shut down all summer because of long-term neglect. It’s finally falling apart just like I’ve been saying for years!
